# Walpulse

> Walpulse creates and analyzes on-chain reputation signals for blockchain wallets.
> The product sold is a **wallet analysis** in three depths: Basic, Standard, Expert (ES: Básica / Estándar / Experta).
> Origins, Activity, Multichain, and Portfolio are **parts** of that analysis, not standalone SKUs.
> All four parts are included in every depth; coverage (networks, activity window, origin hops) scales with the tier.
> A–F grades are a secondary synthesis tied to the tier. The recipient interprets and decides.
> Walpulse does not perform KYC, Travel Rule, UIAF reporting, or compliance decisions.

Canonical site: https://www.walpulse.com

## Catalog (what is sold)

- Basic (ES: Básica): all four signal parts. Ecosystem presence on 15 networks; Portfolio across 38+ networks; Origins + Activity on the top 2 networks (Activity 15 days; Origins first 100 inbound txs by value).
- Standard (ES: Estándar): all four parts with deeper Origins (top 5 networks / 250 inbound + funder read) and Activity 45 days; ecosystem presence on 100 networks.
- Expert (ES: Experta): all four parts at maximum published depth (top 10 networks; Activity 90 days; Origins 500 inbound + 2-hop / counterparty reads).

Coverage depth is commercial; API provider endpoints and synthesis weights are not published.

## Signal parts (engines inside an analysis)

- Origins: source of funds; hop depth and tx cap depend on the tier
- Activity: flow behavior; 15 / 45 / 90-day window by tier; sanctions exposure as a signal (not official screening)
- Multichain: multi-network presence and maturity (all tiers); intensity scales with the tier
- Portfolio: economic quality and on-chain composition (all tiers)

## Principle

We create and analyze signals. The recipient decides.
